E2-2019-T4-P1-S7.trunk: S+V+C：They could even be detrimental（这些行动甚至可能有害）
structure: 主句：They could even be detrimental
└ 结果/伴随分词：satisfying a need
├ 不定式作后置定语：to have done our bit
└ without 介词结构：without ever progressing onto bigger... actions
同位解释：a kind of moral licensing
└ 定语从句(that)：that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge
E2-2019-T4-P1-S7.logic: 句子先判断小行动可能有害，再用分词和 without 说明其心理机制，最后用同位语定义“道德许可”，并由 that 从句展开后果。
notes: do our bit：尽自己的一份力。
those in charge：掌权者、负责人。

E2-2019-T4-P1-S8.trunk: 时间/让步复句：While the conversation remains centered..., we're ignoring the balance of power（当讨论仍聚焦……时，我们忽视了权力关系）
structure: while 状语从句：the conversation ... remains centered on shopping bags and straws
主句：we're ignoring the balance of power
└ 宾语从句(that)：as consumers we must shop sustainably, rather than as citizens hold our governments and industries to account
└ 目的不定式：to push for real systemic change
E2-2019-T4-P1-S8.logic: while 把表层环保讨论与被忽视的权力结构对照；两个 that 依次修饰 balance 并给出其隐含要求，rather than 对比消费者和公民两种身份。
notes: hold somebody to account：要求某人承担责任。

E2-2019-T4-P1-S11.trunk: S+V+O从句：Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues that...（德松布尔主张……）
structure: 主句：Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues
└ 宾语从句(that)：the best way ... is for the change to be structural
├ 不定式作后置定语：to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people
└ 表语：for the change to be structural
E2-2019-T4-P1-S11.logic: that 从句使用“the best way is...”框架；两个不定式分别说明要改变什么，以及最佳方式的结构性本质。
notes: large numbers of people：大量人群。
structural change：通过制度或结构实现的改变。
for + 名词 + to do 是不定式的逻辑主语结构。
